source_stats.source: curated lab-class openness map (W1 truth source)
source_stats.note: Precedence: manual-row value while alive, then per-family exception (survives supersede), then lab class (mixed/unknown → closed). Flip count = rows whose openness value changed vs the pre-overlay value.

arena_match_failures.note: Counts of Arena attach failures by code + most-frequent unmatched model names (from applyArenaElo logs; names span all failure codes). Persisted so attach-rate regressions are diffable run over run.

or_overlay_telemetry.note: Report-only (WS6, M3): overlay attach counts + OpenRouter match-rate histogram over merged rows (production matcher, no behavior change). The unmatched-provider histogram tells us whether context/modality null-coverage is fixable by org-map growth.

price_divergences.note: Level records with aging (first_seen/age_days) + one-run flap grace. Alert on delta only — see scripts/lib/catalog-alerts.mjs. Weekly operator review while any age_days > 7.

stale_cost_task.note: Rows with non-null cost_per_index_task_usd whose current price side (in/out/blended) moved >25% vs the previous draft's same family+effort spine (spineKey identity: model slug + effort tier). Approximation — measurement-time prices are not stored; first run (no previous draft) flags nothing. Data flag only; UI surfacing deferred to the UI/UX line.

intel_consistency.title: AA Intelligence Index vs Arena Elo — consistency measurement, not a replacement score
intel_consistency.note: Report-only (W7 / ticket #194): per-family effort spread of AA Intelligence Index vs Arena Elo plus the rank disagreement between the two orderings. Only rows carrying BOTH metrics on the same row qualify; ranks order that shared pool by family mean (rank 1 = highest, family-name tie-break); rank_gap = |rank_by_index − rank_by_elo|. A consistency measurement — not a replacement score: the AA Index remains the product's single intelligence source and this report never feeds admission or scoring. UI surfacing deferred to the UI/UX line.

watchlist.note: Open weights LIVE on Hugging Face since 2026-08-14 (Apache-2.0, dense vision-language 27B, 262K native context, explicit reasoning mode) — the earlier delay note is superseded. The 27B now has its OWN published benchmarks (GPQA 89.2, SWE-bench Pro 61.7, OSWorld 84.3, Terminal-Bench 2.1 73.0) tracked via data/manual-additions.json row (PRELIMINARY, auto-supersedes when AA measures). Qwen3.8-Max numbers (GPQA 92.6 / TB 2.1 86.6 / SWE Pro 67.7) still belong to Max and must NOT be attributed to the 27B.

Released 2026-08-10; absent from AA snapshot (only Seed-OSS-36B + Doubao Seed Code exist). Tracked via data/manual-additions.json row (PRELIMINARY OpenRouter list data: $0.50/$2.50 per M, context 262,144, text+vision+video; tps/IQ null) — auto-superseded when AA measures the family. ByteDance Seed is in neither CLOUD_LABS nor HELD_LABS (plan WS4 adds it to HELD); row visible under ?catalog=all.

Announced 2026-08-14 (z.ai/blog/glm-5.3); tracked via data/manual-additions.json row (tps=115 AA-cited; IQ/cost null). Watchlist entry doubles as the manual→AA supersede regression case: when AA measures the family, the manual row auto-supersedes and the diff must classify it as a rename.

awaiting_measurement.note: Report-only: merged rows with exactly two of three triple elements, not admitted. Never promoted to the draft. Entries capped per bucket.

non_user_tier_drops.note: Rows with a complete triple dropped for privileged/internal effort tiers users cannot select (NON_USER_TIERS in expand-aa-multi-effort.mjs).

hidden_by_scope.note: Report-only evidence for decision D-H4 (floor + held-lab policy). Zero scope constants changed, zero draft rows added. Held = provider not in CLOUD_LABS, so unlisted providers count as held. Decision 2026-08-14: generation cap (newest+previous per product line) is LIVE in the default scope — c_generation_capped tracks its cut; ?catalog=all remains the uncut archive.

a3_floor_hidden_cloud_since_recent.note: a2 rows released on/after 2025-09-01 — the recent notable cloud pool D-H4 weighs most.

c_generation_capped.note: Cloud rows released ≥ floor, hidden from the default scope ONLY by the D-H4 generation cap (newest + previous per product line). Visible via ?catalog=all.
